3.name: X
3.doc: X is the horizontal position in CSS pixels relative to the element.

4.name: Y
4.doc: Y is the vertical position in CSS pixels relative to the element.

5.name: Code
5.doc: Code is the physical key of a key event, e.g. KeyA or ArrowLeft.

6.doc: PointerId distinguishes the pointers of a multi touch.
6.name: PointerId

7.doc: Buttons is the bit mask of the pressed buttons: 1 primary, 2 secondary, 4 auxiliary.
7.name: Buttons

8.doc: Pressure of the pointer from 0 to 1.
8.name: Pressure

13.doc: DeltaX is the horizontal amount of a wheel event.
13.name: DeltaX

14.doc: DeltaY is the vertical amount of a wheel event.
14.name: DeltaY

15.doc: DeltaZ is the amount of a wheel event along the z axis.
15.name: DeltaZ

16.doc: Key is the value of the key, which respects the keyboard layout, e.g. a or Enter, while Code is the physical key, e.g. KeyA.
16.name: Key

17.doc: Repeat tells, whether the key is held down.
17.name: Repeat
